page.title: Tactical Dashboard
page.description: Scoped command summary, alerts and readiness posture.

personnel.title: Personnel
personnel.description: High readiness means stable staffing, no critical personnel gaps, and enough assigned service members in the current scope.

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.description: The score considers equipment presence, empty inventory gaps, and critical shortage or overflow alerts.

weapons.title: Weapons
weapons.description: The score reflects weapon availability, category coverage, and absence of critical no-weapon alerts.

specialists.title: Specialists
specialists.description: The score drops when specialties have no assigned personnel or visible staffing gaps.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Only buildings intended for deployment are evaluated, including occupancy and overloaded facilities.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Critical and high alerts reduce readiness; no active operational problems improves the final status.

events.title: Latest events
events.empty: No audit events in current scope

problems.title: Problem zones
problems.noCritical: No critical alerts in current scope
